description: PAID tool ($0.05 USDC via x402, Base). Walk a ticker's latest close forward through the real session-by-session returns of a past window (for example AMC from 2021-01-22). Returns every projected session with the real historical bar it mirrors. A conditional historical-return forecast, not a calibrated probability.

mirror.description: ticker whose history is mirrored (default: same)

name: mirror_projection
